target: AArch64 QEMU virt, PCI graphical terminal with serial command probe
verified: The first Person example runs and reaches its key wait without an exception.
The ARM64 adaptation performs a byte access at a biased base plus displacement -128 and reads back 0x5A.
Both key waits complete and the terminal remains usable: 40+2 returns 42 and zstatus reports failed=0.
not_verified: The original x86-specific negative class-member layout cannot be reproduced as an AArch64 class ABI; the bootstrap source demonstrates an equivalent signed address displacement instead.
Live UTM behavior and physical Pi behavior.
scope_note: Runtime acceptance covers the ARM64 source adaptation, not the unchanged x86 class layout semantics.
